notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability and Golgari Germination.
Resolve the Putrid Goblin trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both counters from Putrid Goblin and the counter from the Saproling token, causing yourself to mill three cards and allowing you to return a permanent card with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
